{'index': 0, 'translation': "Trump's repeatedly shifting timeline for ending a war with Iran has been thoroughly scrutinised in a new montage clip released on Tuesday."}

{'index': 1, 'translation': "The supercut, produced through a collaboration between the conservative-leaning nonprofit Home of the Brave and the progressive veterans group VoteVets, highlights Trump's numerous statements hinting that the conflict he controversially launched in February was nearing its end."}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'The two groups also simultaneously launched an online calendar tracking tool, AboutTwoWeeks.com, which documents dozens of instances in which Trump promised the war would soon be over.'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': '"The president has repeatedly promised to end the war in \'about two weeks\' — these are just lies, meant to paper over the fact that he has no plan and no cards left to play," said Sarah Matthews, a spokesperson for Home of the Brave and a former deputy White House press secretary during Trump\'s first term who has since become a vocal Trump critic.'}

{'index': 4, 'translation': 'Matthews added to HuffPost: "We will not stop condemning this insult to American heroes, because they joined the military to give this country the best of themselves, and Trump is repaying them with the worst of himself."'}

{'index': 5, 'translation': 'On Home of the Brave\'s Substack page, the organisation noted that "Trump once promised to be a president who would deliver \'no more wars,\' and repeatedly vowed to keep America out of foreign military quagmires."'}

{'index': 6, 'translation': 'The post also stated: "The moment he took office, he launched an illegal war against Iran without seeking congressional approval and without even attempting to make a credible case to the American public for military action."'}

{'index': 7, 'translation': 'The two groups said the campaign\'s purpose is to "mobilise veterans and pro-democracy Americans against this administration\'s disastrous foreign and military policies" ahead of the November 2026 midterm elections.'}

{'index': 8, 'translation': 'Trump has repeatedly claimed the war is essentially over, but on Monday he acknowledged it was still ongoing, saying: "We\'re going to be winning that war very soon."'}
